chapter.verse: Gamlumna a ven ciangin Paul in nungzuite ama' kiangah vaikhak a, amaute a hanthot khit ciangin mangpha paihin Macedonia gamke zuan dingin dingkhia hi.
Tua gamke teng nawkin hanthotna tampi a piak khit ciangin Greece gam tung hi.
Tua takah kha thum taam a, tembaw tawh Syria gam pai ding a sawm laitak Jew mite in amah suam sawm ahih manin Macedonia gamke lam pan ciah ding khensat hi.
Pyrrhus' tapa, Berea khuami Sopater in amah zui a, Thessalonica khuami Aristarchus leh Secundus, Derbe khuami Gaius, leh Timothy, Asia mi Tychicus leh Trophimus, -te zong ahi hi.
Tu-a teng na ma pai uh a, Troas khua ah ko hong ngak uh hi.
Ahih hangin ko pen Silngo Sawhloh Anlum pawi nite khit, Philippi khua pan tembaw tawh dingkhia-in ni nga sungin Troas khua amau' kiangah ka tung uh a, tua takah ni sagih ka taam uh hi.
Nipikal ni masani-in anlum balnen dingin ka kikhop uh ciangin Paul in amaute thu kuppih a, a zingciang zinkhiat sawm ahih manin zankim dong a thugen zomsuak hi.
Ka kikhopna uh inndei tungnung ah meivak tampi om hi.
Eutychus minnei tangval khat tawlet ah tu a, Paul' thugen sauveipi sungin lusu-in ihmu dipdep hi. Lim ihmut lua ahih manin dawl thumna pan kia a, a sisa-in kitawm hi.
Ahih hangin Paul kumsuk a, tangvalpa' tungah kunsukin a ang ah pom a, “Patau henhan kei un, a sungah husanna om lai hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Paul kahto a, anlum balnenin ne uh hi. Tua khit ciangin zingsang khuavak dong amaute tawh sauveipi kiho a, tua ciangin dingkhia hi.
Amaute in pasalno a nungta-in ciahpih uh a, noptuamna lianpi ngah uh hi.
Tua ciangin tembaw omna ah ka ma pai uh a, Paul ka zot nading uh Assos khua ka zuan uh hi. Hih pen Paul' vaihawmsa hi a, amah khe lam tawh Assos a pai sawm ahi hi.
Assos ah amah hong dawk ciangin tembaw tungah ka pi uh a, Mitylene khua ka pai uh hi.
Tua khua pan ka paisuak uh a, a zingciangin Chios tuikulh galkhat ka tung uh hi. A zingciangin Samos tuikulh gei ka nawk uh a, a thaiciangin Miletus khua ka tung uh hi.
A hang pen Paul in Asia gam ah hun a bei loh nadingin Ephesus khua khengsuak ding a khensatsa hi a, tua pen a pian theih ding leh Pentecost ni-in Jerusalem tung nuamin a nawhtat ahi hi.
Tu-in Paul in Miletus khua pan Ephesus khua ah mi sawl a, pawlpi makaite ama' kiangah a pai dingin sam hi.
Amaute hong tun ciangin Paul in hih bangin gen hi: “Asia gam kong sik masakni-a kipan a tawntungin note tawh kei hong bangci omkhop cih nomaumah in na thei uh hi.
Jew mite' hong suam sawmna hanga kei tunga hong piang zia-etnate ka thuak kawmin kiniamkhiatna leh khitui naptui tawh Topa' na ka sem hi.
Phattuam nading thu khatpeuh hong gen lo-a kong ipcip bangmah om lo a, milak hileh inn tek ah hileh note kong hilhcian hi.
Pasian' mai-ah kisikna thu leh i Topa Jesu Khris upna thu zong Jew mi leh Greek mi na nih uh tungah teci khauhtak kong pang hi.
Tu-in, en un, Kha' hong khihna hangin Jerusalem a pai ding ka hi a, tua takah bang teng tuak ding cih ka thei kei hi.
Khua citeng ah Kha Siangtho' hong lah teci kician khat bel om a, kolbulh khaukhih leh gentheihna in kei hong ngak cih thu ahi hi.

Himah taleh Pasian' hehpihna tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu khauhtakin teci pang ding cih, Topa Jesu' kiangpana ka ngah ka maban leh seppina ka tangtut zawh nading ahih nakleh ka nuntakna zong bangmah a man lo-in ka ngaihsun lel hi.
Tu-in, en un, kumpigam thu tangko dinga kong vak kawikawina note' lakpan kuamah in ka maitang hong mukik lo ding cih ka thei hi.
Tua ahih manin vekpi' tungah sisan vai ka siang hi ci-in tuni-in note' kiangah teci kong pang hi.
A hang pen Pasian' lamlahna a bupin note' kiangah genkhiat ding ka pelh om lo hi.
Nomaumah ahi zongin, ama' sisan tawh a tatkhiat Pasian' pawlpi a cing a kem dingin Kha Siangtho in pawlpi sya dinga hong koihna tuuhonte a bupin ahi zongin limtak na kinbawl un.
Ka zinkhiat khit ciangin note' lakah ngia gilote hong lutin tuuhonte zong map lo ding uh cih ka thei hi.
No' sungpan mahmahin zong mite hong kithawi ding a, amau' lamah nungzuite kaikhia nuamin thu a lehlamin hong gen ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, kum thum sung khitui naptui tawh a sun a zan tawlnga lo-in mi kim kong taaibawl phawk unla na pilvang un.
Tu-in note hong khangliansak theipa leh siansuahna a ngahte khempeuh tawh a kibangin gamh hong pia theipa Pasian' kiang leh ama' hehpihna thu sungah note kong ap hi.
Kua' ngun, kua' kham, kua' nikten puansilh ka deihgawh kei hi.
Hih ka khutte in kei' kitangsapte leh ka kithuahpihte hong huh hong van cih nomaumah in na thei uh hi.
Hih bangin nasep hahkatin a zawngkhalte i huh nading ahi zongin, ‘Ngahna sangin piakna thupha hizaw’ a ci Topa Jesu' kampau i phawk nading ahi zongin na khempeuh ah note kong lak khinzo hi.”
Hih thu teng a gen khit ciangin Paul khukdinin amaute khempeuh tawh thungenkhawm hi.
Amaute a vekun kap ngeingai uh a, Paul kawi-in nam uh hi.
Ama' maitang mukik lo ding uh a cihna hangin a dah diak uh ahi hi. Tua ciangin tembaw omna ah Paul kha uh hi.
